result.summary: The page is mostly functional and visually coherent, but a raw localization placeholder string ("home_feed.popular_title") is exposed as a section title. Minor formatting inconsistency also appears in the delivery-fee labels.

issues.description: A raw localization key is displayed as a section heading: "home_feed.popular_title".
issues.suggestion: Replace the placeholder key with the intended localized heading text (e.g., "Popular near you").

issues.description: The delivery fee uses an unusual localized format ("€0.90 delivery" and "€1.90 delivery"), with the decimal separator and currency placement looking inconsistent with the rest of the UI.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent locale-aware currency format such as "€0.90 delivery fee" or "Delivery €0.90" across all cards.
